map.输入制冷量与蒸发/冷凝温度，计算理想 COP 并推荐压缩机类型: Enter cooling capacity and evaporating/condensing temperature to compute ideal COP and recommend a compressor type.
map.制冷设备选型：基于制冷量、蒸发温度与冷凝温度，按制冷循环（压缩式/吸收式）计算输: Refrigeration equipment selection: based on cooling capacity, evaporating temperature and condensing temperature, compute input power by the refrigeration cycle (compression/absorption) and recommend compressor type and refrigerant (e.g. R134a/R410A) by capacity range, for refrigeration system design.
map.💡 卡诺 COP=Te_abs/(Tc_abs-Te_abs)；实际 COP=卡: Tip: Carnot COP=Te_abs/(Tc_abs-Te_abs); actual COP=Carnot COP times 0.55; compressor type recommended by capacity bands.
map.实际 COP 取卡诺效率的 55%，视设备水平在 0.45-0.65 之间: Actual COP takes 55% of Carnot efficiency, ranging 0.45-0.65 by equipment level.
map.涡旋式适用于小冷量，螺杆式适用于中等冷量，离心式适用于大冷量: Scroll suits small capacity, screw suits medium, centrifugal suits large.
map.冷凝温度与蒸发温度温差越大，COP 越低: Larger temperature difference between condensing and evaporating means lower COP.
map.📚 深度解析：制冷设备选型计算（COP、功率与压缩机类型）: In-depth: Refrigeration equipment selection calculation (COP, power and compressor type)
map.机组选型：由制冷量与蒸发/冷凝温度估算输入功率与机型: Unit selection: from cooling capacity and evaporating/condensing temperature estimate input power and model.
map.能效评估：算卡诺 COP 与实际 COP，判断能效水平: Energy-efficiency assessment: compute Carnot COP and actual COP, judge efficiency level.
map.工况优化：评估降低冷凝温度或提高蒸发温度的节能效果: Condition optimization: assess the energy-saving effect of lowering condensing or raising evaporating temperature.
map.算法：蒸发/冷凝温度换算为开尔文（+273.15）；卡诺理想 COP = Te/: Algorithm: evaporating/condensing temperature to Kelvin (+273.15); Carnot ideal COP = Te/(Tc - Te); actual COP = Carnot COP times 0.55 (thermodynamic perfection); input power = cooling capacity/actual COP (kW); condensing heat load = cooling capacity + input power; temp rise = Tc - Te. Model recommendation: Q<25 kW scroll, <500 kW screw, else centrifugal. Refrigerant: Te<-30 deg C R404A/R507 (low temp), <0 deg C R407C/R410A (mid-low), else R134a/R410A (high). Efficiency rating: actual COP >4 excellent, >3 good, >2 fair, else low.
map.例：制冷量 100kW、蒸发 −10℃、冷凝 35℃ → 卡诺 COP 5.85: Example: cooling 100 kW, evaporate -10 deg C, condense 35 deg C -> Carnot COP 5.85, actual 3.22, input power 31.09 kW, condensing load 131.09 kW, rise 45 deg C, recommend screw compressor, refrigerant R407C/R410A (mid-low), efficiency good. If 15 kW, -25 deg C, 40 deg C -> Carnot 3.82, actual 2.10, power 7.14 kW, condensing load 22.14 kW, rise 65 deg C, recommend scroll compressor, efficiency fair. Same 100 kW unit if condensing drops to 30 deg C -> rise to 40 deg C, Carnot 6.58, actual 3.62, power down to 27.64 kW, about 11.1% saving vs 35 deg C.
map.热力完善度（实际 COP/卡诺 COP）反映压缩机与换热器的不可逆损失，实际机组: Thermodynamic perfection (actual COP/Carnot COP) reflects the irreversible losses of compressor and heat exchangers; real units are generally 0.4 to 0.6: large centrifugal and flooded screw can take 0.55 to 0.65, small air-cooled often only 0.40 to 0.50. This tool uniformly takes 0.55, moderately optimistic; for energy budget verify against the specific unit sample COP.
map.为什么降低冷凝温度能明显节能？: Why does lowering condensing temperature save energy noticeably?
map.COP = Te/(Tc−Te)，温升 Tc−Te 在分母上。上例把冷凝从 35: COP = Te/(Tc-Te), with temp rise Tc-Te in the denominator. In the example condensing from 35 to 30 deg C, rise shrinks from 45 to 40 deg C, COP rises from 3.22 to 3.62 (+12.5%), input power drops from 31.09 to 27.64 kW accordingly. Therefore
map.维护、冷凝器清洗、增大换热面积这类降低冷凝温度的措施，往往是制冷系统性价比最高的: maintenance, condenser cleaning and larger heat-exchange area that lower condensing temperature are often the most cost-effective energy-saving measures for refrigeration systems.
